svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Who the model learns from, and who it is tested on — split by patient, never by file
SeizeIT2 · 125 patients · 11,626 hours · 883 seizures. Every patient's recordings go to one side only. Three tiers of evidence, each opened once.

g.text: one dot = one patient, all of their recordings

svg.text: Tier 1 · Development
96 patients · 8,715 h · 702 seizures · 5 folds, split by patient (GroupKFold), FBTC spread 8 / 7 / 6 / 6 / 6 · hashed in data/catalog/splits.sha256
Rotate 5 times so every patient is held out exactly once. Inside the 4 training folds, an inner split tunes τ and the rule
thresholds — the held-out fold is never touched for tuning.
3 seeds per model → 15 cells per model in the training grid. This is where every version (v01, v02, …) is accepted or rejected.
Why not split by file or by window?
The same patient's seizures look alike. Within-patient splits leak identity and inflate accuracy — in the 2025 SzCORE challenge,
self-reported F1 of 80–90 % dropped to 2–43 % on a hidden hospital.
A proposed sub-001…030 / 031…042 split was rejected: its "test" side was dominated by two patients (75 + 55 of 187 seizures).
Tier 2 · Locked internal test
29 patients · 2,912 h · 181 seizures (22 FBTC from 9 patients)
🔒 closed until docs/PREREGISTRATION.sha256 exists
Frozen model, frozen τ, opened once. The feature
extractor refuses these subjects without the hash file.
After that single run it becomes development data.
Tier 3 · External tests — other hospitals, other devices, home
Never trained on. Scalp EEG mapped to the behind-the-ear channels via the T7–P7 / T8–P8 proxy; labels opened once per set.

g.text: wrist ACC at home · false alarms

svg.text: Also: Mayo MSG home heart-rate (HR rule over months) · Arbune 2020 EMG (relationship study) · CHB-MIT optional (paediatric EEG).
No external set is ever used as training negatives.
Dropped: SeizeIT1 (no longer shared), Kaggle re-uploads of SeizeIT2, synthetic notebooks, Bonn/UPF segments.
The order of operations

g.text: 1 Relationship study (Exp R) on tier 1 only
3 A → B → C ablation, all dev hours (v02)
4 Self-iteration, one change per version, fixed accept rule
7 Tier 3 opened once each · independent re-computation

svg.text: Same procedure as the sibling SlopeAI project.
Current position (17 Oct 2026)
Step 2: v01 baseline is training on the five development folds. Tiers 2 and 3 have not been downloaded or opened. No held-out number exists yet.
